observations: org.that_organization and scope.org_unnamed are the same ru string, 'этой организации'. English distinguishes 'that organization' from 'this organization', but Russian's feminine demonstrative is identical in the genitive/dative/prepositional and both slots demand one of those cases, so the collapse is correct here rather than a lost distinction. Recorded so a later reader does not file it again.

'в хабе {org}' (empty.org.body, and the pre-existing status.scope.shared_with) is apposition: correct with the shipped fallback 'этой организации' and with an indeclinable foreign name; a declinable Russian organization name would want quotes. The pattern predates this commit and the new key follows it — out of scope, not gating.

'тариф Radient Team' is the established ru rendering of 'Team plan' (9 shipped strings, including ui.agents.publication.team_plan_required.headline, byte-identical to the new org.plan_headline, and the pre-existing teams sibling). Not a deviation.

findings.reason: {category} sits after the preposition 'в категории', which governs the prepositional case, but the value the render site passes is the taxonomy label in the nominative — 'Бухгалтерия', 'Право', 'Продажи', 'Другое', 'Соцсети' (ui.hub.taxonomy.category.*). 'Нет агентов в категории Бухгалтерия.' is ungrammatical for every one of the 16 labels. The English sidecar forbids the other repair ('insert it whole, do not decline or re-case it'), so the label has to be cited rather than declined: «ёлочки» is the ru style guide's prose quote pair, and the catalogue already cites placeholders that way (ui.hub.teams.pull_failed '«{name}»', teams.public.search_miss '«{query}»', ui.hub.detail.delist_body '«{name}»').

findings.reason: 'его' is masculine/neuter and cannot refer to the organization: 'организация' is feminine, and the shipped fallback for an unreadable name is scope.org_unnamed = 'этой организации', also feminine. In that reachable path the pronoun has no agreeing antecedent and attaches to 'хабе' (masculine), so the sentence reads 'for the hub's members' — 'участники хаба' is not this surface's vocabulary (members belong to the org or team). The same mismatch appears with any feminine organization name (Ромашка, Альфа). The audited teams sibling avoids the pronoun entirely — ui.hub.teams.org.empty 'Команды, открытые для участников {org}, появятся здесь.' — and keeping the pages/teams pair in one voice is what the programme asks for.
